niche: Nepal trekking and adventure travel business
scoring_guidance: Score clips on suitability for a 9:16 Instagram/TikTok reel promoting a Nepal trekking business. Reward: sweeping mountain vistas (Annapurna, Everest, Manaslu, Langtang), clients smiling/celebrating at viewpoints, prayer flags, sunrise/sunset alpenglow, suspension bridges, traditional villages, action shots (hiking, river crossings), tea house culture. Penalize: blurry/shaky beyond style, dark indoor shots, unflattering angles of clients, anything with sensitive content. Bonus for clips that work without sound and have clear vertical-friendly composition.
